announcement: This release closes three tenant isolation gaps: nginx logs were readable across tenants, Redis accounts could enumerate neighbour key names, and the repair tool loosened home directory permissions instead of restoring them. It adds live site migration from cPanel, Plesk, and DirectAdmin over SSH, granular backup restore with tracked bulk jobs, and ten further interface languages. It also fixes a domain serving 403 on filesystems that ignore ACLs and a panel update card that could spin forever after the service restart.
